if: the document is a payment voucher referred to in clause (g) of sub-section (3) of section 31
it is issued under rule 52 of the CGST Rules, 2017
then: the payment voucher MUST carry the signature or digital signature of the supplier or his authorised representative
note: One mandatory particular of rule 52(j), addressable on its own so that a missing field names the clause it breaches.
